header.name: Advanced Internet of Things
header.description: This course will be dealing with advanced topics in Internet of Things. This course is a sequel of the Internet of Things course which introduced students to basics of foundational IoT technologies. This course delves deeper into some of the technologies pertinent to IoT. Students are expected to learn by implementing protocols etc. in their programmming assignments. They will be exposed to some of the latest research findings in IoT and expected to perform thought exercises by writing research project proposals extending the frontiers of current IoT research. Finally, students will implement working prototypes of IoT systems inspired by algorithms proposed in research papers.

outcomes.label: CO1
outcomes.raw_text: Students will critically review research studies/results in IoT

outcomes.label: CO2
outcomes.raw_text: Students will implement IoT concepts in different application domains/scenarios

outcomes.label: CO3
outcomes.raw_text: Students will design new IoT research proposals

outcomes.label: CO4
outcomes.raw_text: Students will develop working prototype of an IoT system

lecture_topics: IoT Basics: Concepts, Technologies, OS, Security, Machine Learning, Network
Analysis of system architecture and design in different IoT applications
Sensing using Smartphones, Wearables, other body worn and body embedded systems
Research frontiers in mobile based Sensing
IoT Protocols: Design and Implementation of network, management and other protocols in IoT applications

assessments.type_label: Projects (#1 due by midsem + #2 due by endsem)
